notes.title: UI Update!
notes.notes:
We've started the update of our UI, including a new way to choose which arcade game you and your friends want to play.

Rebrand includes:
[list]
[*] Updated Logo
[*] Updated backgrounds and colors
[*] Updated game selection menu
[*] Updated backend functionality to eventually allow for up to 10 players (not set up yet)
[/list]
